exposure: provider type (general obstetrician/gynecologists (OBGYN), maternal-fetal medicine (MFM), or endocrinology)
outcome: timing of pharmacotherapy initiation (assessed by percent of abnormal glucose values)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 428 women with a singleton pregnancy and a diagnosis of A2GDM (GDM requiring pharmacotherapy), who delivered in a tertiary care center between 2009 and 2019.
finding: Provider type was not associated with the percent of elevated glucose values at the time of pharmacotherapy initiation for A2GDM, but endocrinology providers were more likely to initiate insulin as first-line pharmacotherapy.
